subject: Vendor activation: invoice submission channel & PO stamping checks
content:
From: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@olivetech.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: OliveTech Onboarding <onboarding@olivetech.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Jul 2028 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding question — portal vs email for invoices

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for the quick walkthrough earlier. A couple of questions from finance as we finalize our onboarding pack:

- We can use your vendor portal if preferred, but need clarity on the exact CSV header format your AP expects (we generate on our ERP). Can you share a minimal sample?
- If we fallback to email (some of our subsidiaries prefer that), what subject token or PO-stamp format do you need so invoices route correctly?
- Do you require the PO number in the filename or the CSV row?

Attached: vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx (our completed form)

Appreciate any sample lines we can use to test.

Best,
Sarah Lewis
Finance Ops — OliveTech

---
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@olivetech.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Jul 2028 09:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding question — portal vs email for invoices

Hi Sarah — great to see the form, thanks. Short answers up front:

- Portal is preferred: it provides deterministic PO matching and faster ACKs.
- Email fallback supported with subject-token + PDF/CSV attachment.
- PO number is preferred as a separate CSV column called PO_NUMBER; filename is a secondary signal.

Below are two practical options you can test. I attached a sample CSV row (sample_invoice.csv) and a short PDF with PO-stamp examples.

Portal (recommended):
- Upload CSV or PDF in the portal UI -> we extract/validate and return an acknowledgement within 30–60s for valid submissions.
- Required CSV headers: INVOICE_NUMBER, INVOICE_DATE (YYYY-MM-DD), SUPPLIER_NAME, PO_NUMBER, LINE_DESCRIPTION, QUANTITY, UNIT_PRICE, TAX_AMOUNT, TOTAL_AMOUNT, CURRENCY
- PO matching logic: exact match on PO_NUMBER + supplier id. If multiple PO lines match we attempt intelligent allocation by LINE_DESCRIPTION similarity.

Email fallback (if you must):
- Send to billing@redwood.com with subject: "Invoice: <PO_NUMBER> :: OliveTech" OR include header line in the CSV with PO_NUMBER column.
- Attachments: prefer CSV or PDF. If PDF only, please include the PO in the subject and first page header.
- Max attachment size: 25MB.

Acceptable filename pattern (email fallback): OliveTech_INV_<INVOICE_NUMBER>_PO<PO_NUMBER>.csv (helps manual triage)

Action items for OliveTech:
1) Try the attached sample_invoice.csv (single-line example) against the portal sandbox (link below).
2) If you will use email fallback, send one test email to billing@redwood.com with subject token and attach a PDF.

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-example-onboarding

Thanks —
Mateo Alvarez
Vendor Enablement Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Jul 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding question — portal vs email for invoices

Looping finance/OPS notes:
- For Dedicated customers we can be stricter on portal-only, but OliveTech is a hosted API customer so email fallback is allowed with the token.
- Can we add an internal rule to auto-reject if PO_NUMBER is missing and amount > $25k? Kimberly, what do you think?

Vanessa

---
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Jul 2028 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding question — portal vs email for invoices

Agree w/ Vanessa. Proposed rule:
- If submission channel == email AND PO_NUMBER is blank AND TOTAL_AMOUNT >= 25000 -> route to manual queue and send requester a "missing PO" ACK email with next steps.
- If portal AND PO missing -> reject with error: "PO required for vendor activation".

Karthik, can you add the rule to the onboarding checklist and confirm the ACK wording? I will attach the PO-stamp examples to the vendor record.

Kimberly Park
AP Program Manager

- The CSV sometimes includes a multi-line description field (commas). Do you prefer encapsulated CSV (quoted fields) or a pipe-delimited file? We can configure either.

Also attaching our completed onboarding form per your checklist. Let me know when you have the sandbox link.

Regards,
Sarah
